briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch intensifies race as US-China tensions spike over frontier model exports

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs race toward AGI with new reasoning models while regulatory scrutiny mounts. Compute shortages persist despite massive buildouts. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation gains traction in security circles.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with 40% reasoning gains; Anthropic's Claude 4.5 focuses on agentic workflows; Google DeepMind's Gemini 3 and Meta's Llama 4.1 compete on multimodal benchmarks. xAI and DeepSeek push open-weight alternatives.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. Regulators demand audit trails while DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell racks at scale; Microsoft and Google announce 10GW data center expansions in Texas and Arizona. TSMC ramps 2nm process for next-gen AI chips.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will export controls on advanced chips slow China's AGI timeline or accelerate indigenous breakthroughs?
